sourcePolicy: Original Ready2Go draft questions. These are not official JAMB past questions and require human subject-matter review before public release.

questions.question: A wholesaler mainly buys goods in bulk from producers and sells them to…

options.A: final consumers only in every case

questions.explanation: Wholesalers commonly sell bulk goods to retailers and other businesses.

questions.question: The principle of indemnity is intended to…

options.B: restore the insured to a similar financial position, subject to the policy

questions.explanation: Indemnity aims to compensate an insured loss within policy terms, not create profit.

questions.question: A cheque is an instruction to a bank to…

options.B: pay a specified amount from an account, subject to conditions

questions.explanation: A cheque is a payment order drawn on a bank account, subject to valid presentation.

questions.question: One major function of advertising is to…
questions.explanation: Advertising informs audiences about products and can attempt to persuade them.

questions.question: A document acknowledging receipt of goods or payment is commonly a…
questions.explanation: A receipt records that goods or payment have been received.
